description:
The proposals include:
• Demolition of existing single storey Ground Floor extension
• Erection of pitched roof full-width Ground Floor extension to align with neighbouring extension at 76 Haydon
Park Road
• Erection of pitched roof First Floor extension to align with neighbouring extension at 76 Haydon Park Road
• Removal of rear chimney breast at First Floor
• Re-alignment of rear window at First Floor
• Obscuring the front window above the main doors
